actor.description: The login the change was checked as: its merged pull request's author

detail.description: Why the change could not be checked. Omitted otherwise

directives_from.description: `pull request body`, or why only the commit message was read

findings.description: Every error and warning of the change's report, in report order; empty when the check itself could not run. The message is never included: a finding can echo secret material

pr.description: Pull request number, from the forge or the subject's `(#N)`

reason.description: Why the change could not be checked: the report's `could_not_check.reason`, or `forge` when its merged pull request could not be read. Omitted otherwise

sha.description: Full commit id of the replayed change

skipped_checks.description: Parts of gates skipped because the configuration names a file this change does not have yet; empty when the check itself could not run

what.description: What was skipped, as the gate's note names it (for example ``group `versions` ``)

description: The summary `discipline replay --json` prints: each replayed change's verdict under the configuration, and per-gate counts. Changes are labelled `#N` (pull request) or by a 10-character commit id.

could_not_check_by_reason.description: The reason a change could not be checked (the report's `could_not_check.reason`) -> the changes

errors_by_gate.description: Gate id -> the changes it blocked with an error finding

refused_overrides_by_gate.description: Gate id -> the changes whose override of that gate `fail_on_overrides` refused

schema_version.description: This schema's version: a field added keeps it, one renamed, removed or retyped raises it

skipped_by_gate.description: Gate id -> the changes that skipped part of it because the configuration names a file the change does not have yet (the configuration is newer than the change)

warnings_by_gate.description: Gate id -> the number of changes with a warning from it

title: DisciplineReplay
